title: CarrierSupply
description: A source of carrier energy at a carrier bus, such as a natural gas import point or a biomass supply.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type must have unique names, but components of different types can share a name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`).

bus.description: ID of the carrier bus that this component is connected to.

max_active_power.description: Maximum energy flow that this supply delivers. Units: MW.

flow_limits.description: Minimum and maximum delivered flow as fractions of `max_active_power`. An attached time series can make the limits time-varying. Units: 1.

variable_cost.description: Cost per unit of energy delivered. Units: USD/MWh.
